label: Bible Study
prompt: I was _____ when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
verse: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
note: A pilgrim's Song of Degrees — sung on the road up to Jerusalem's temple.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is _____ before God?
verse: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?
note: Five sparrows for two farthings — Luke's bulk-deal price — and still God forgets not one.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Samson took hold of the two middle _____ upon which the house stood, and on which it was borne up, of the one with his right hand, and of the other with his left.
verse: And Samson took hold of the two middle pillars upon which the house stood, and on which it was borne up, of the one with his right hand, and of the other with his left.
note: Samson's last act: two middle pillars, one in each hand, and the Philistine temple came down.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose _____ and maker is God.
verse: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
note: Abraham lived in tents because he was looking for a city with foundations — designed and built by God.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Doth not behave itself _____, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;
verse: Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;
note: Love's etiquette: it 'doth not behave itself unseemly' — no rudeness — and it is not easily provoked.
